items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's not the guy they call brother Cornbread, is it? [INTERVIEWEE] No, I don't know. Jim Thomas. No, I don't know. Probably not.

ctx.x: A while. In the old days. I know, I'm talking the old days. Well, it was hard. He was pretty good. And there's a fellow down in the road there by the name of, they call it Thomas. Thomas they call it. Thomas. He's from down in the road there. Thomas man, I used to play with him. I don't know who that is. Doc Feller, Thomas. He stayed in the city a good while. What's his first name, Pa? I know his first name, Thomas, Doc Feller. Is he living there? I don't know if Thomas lives in. Yeah, I think he lives.
That's not the guy they call brother Cornbread, is it?
No, I don't know. Jim Thomas. No, I don't know. Probably not. He was really good, but he wasn't much of a music man. He was a rope man.
